title: Plugin Health Audit
description: Clean up plugin bloat — deactivate unused plugins, check for abandoned software, and resolve conflicts.

steps.title: Inventory Active Plugins
steps.instructions: List every active plugin with its purpose and owner (agency vs client). Flag duplicates that do the same job.

steps.title: Deactivate Unused Plugins
steps.instructions: Deactivate plugins not used in the last 90 days. Monitor the site for a week before deleting.

steps.title: Replace Abandoned Plugins
steps.instructions: Identify plugins with no updates in 12+ months or incompatible with your PHP/WP version. Plan replacements.

steps.title: Verify Premium Licenses
steps.instructions: Confirm paid plugins have valid licenses for updates. Document renewal dates and billing owner.

steps.title: Test for Plugin Conflicts
steps.instructions: After changes, test homepage, admin, forms, and checkout. Use health check or staging if errors appear.

steps.title: Delete Inactive Plugin Files
steps.instructions: Remove deactivated plugins you will not reuse. Fewer installed plugins reduces attack surface and update noise.

steps.title: Document Final Plugin Stack
steps.instructions: Save the approved plugin list with version numbers. Attach to client docs or your agency wiki.
